training_recipe.mask: Exactly71of95tokens perframe (74.7368percent), full95tokens including masktokens enterencoder; no visible-token deletion
training_recipe.input: Log-magnitude dB ONLY, pointwise global frame mean/SD;3receiversx114subcarriersx10packetcolumns, no calibrated packet timing/phase claim
training_recipe.context: 8causalframes ending canonicalendpoint, retained40frame quality guard from frozen covariance cache
training_recipe.shuffled: Within same8frame history, roll seven adjacent partner embeddings by4; pairtime distances4or-3, no true adjacent or identical pairing; reconstruction inputs and mask unchanged
training_recipe.supervision: Same8rawframes/steps asSSL; standardizedendpoint34coordinateMSE, endpointlabelsTRAINonly; no early stopping. Allarms subsequently same sourceTRAINendpoint labels in frozenRFFprobe
training_recipe.selection: Fixed finalstep encoder; independently select source-onlyRFF512 ridgealpha .001/.01/.1/1/10 by equal-source-room validation NJE; ALLchoices saved before heldscores
training_recipe.scope: One E02developmentfold/seed, sourceE01/E03TRAINonly optimizer. HIP-ROOT-RELATIVE articulation only, not fullimagepose/hiplocation; no E04,target enrollment,RGB,3D or final efficacy claim
training_recipe.limits: Full-frame normalization precedes patch masking: observed values in masked patches contribute two frame mean/SD statistics, so this is not strict masked-raw-target independence. No pose, future, or cross-frame statistics enter. Masked training versus full-unmasked embedding inference distribution differs. Pointwise normalization discards overall frame gain; all encoder frames process independently before8embedding concatenation. Prior source development exposure remains disclosed.

audit.temporal_baseline_scope: The original temporal control is a hash-bound, index-joined saved baseline qualified upstream. Its underlying old encoder is not rerun here; its calibrated corrections are independently reconstructed.
audit.motion_definition: Recordwise subtract first frame, then temporal mean. Target energy <= N*(64*float64eps*max(1,coordinate scale))^2 is undefined/None; no rounding creates motion.

config.normalization: Per-column LOCAL TRAIN mean/SD only; SD floor.05 in each feature's declared units. No global pose maps or fitted heads
config.raw_controls: Full54720D inter-RX log-ratio/circular-phase histories; full27360D raw log-magnitude histories/20 with same-frame per-receiver finite-median fill only
config.quality: RF-only common mask BEFORE loading local labels: each history <=5percent invalid inter-RX pairs; each constituent frame has finite nonconstant observed magnitude and at least one observed sample per receiver
config.encoder: Five fixed-final4000-step encoder backbones, CPU eval/inference only; frame embeddings64D then causal8frame concat512. Global pose_head and decoder never called
config.equation: Exact dual(K+alpha*I)A=Y-Y_LOCAL_TRAIN_mean; linearK=XXtrain.T/D or exp(-d2/(2*median_ALL_LOCAL_TRAIN_pair_d2)); no D-by-D fit
config.selection: LOCAL earlier validation NJE independently per arm/hip-relative or full-image target; tie linear before RBF, then stronger alpha. All choices sealed before query labels are scored
config.controls: Local TRAIN mean and linear endpoint-time trend; fixed seed90210 within-query prediction shuffle. Strong raw controls always reported
config.gate: Observability only per hip-relative arm: record-centered bodyR2>.5, aligned-minus-shuffled bodyR2>.3, NJE<.75TRAINmean. Never room/person/action generalization
config.burden: 111 dense endpoint labels before RF-quality exclusions,118 raw frames span11.8nominalseconds; same person, room and action. Query104windows before exclusions
config.exposure: S04 has historical development exposure and source-VAL labels selected global RFF heads AFTER final encoders. Those heads/maps are not used here; no untouched-source-person claim
config.inference: RBF returns LOCAL TRAIN target mean far from references; no fitted joint confidence or camera input during inference

config.input: Current frame phi is last64 of each frozen eight-frame512D embedding; no global pose-head/map weights used

config.context: Symmetric midpoint(phi_t+phi_past)/2; TRAIN mean/SD floor.001 and TRAIN PCA64/sign-fixed basis; TRAIN PCscoreRMS floor.001
config.design: delta_scaled/sqrt64 concatenated with (context_PC/PCscale outer delta_scaled)/sqrt(64*r); no intercept. Rank0 is unconditional displacement
